gate_title: Measured Capacity Re-presentation After G8 Redesign

proposed_authority_delta.on_freeze_measured_capacity: Replace the original SRFDI-G8 REDESIGN capacity disposition with FREEZE_MEASURED_CAPACITY for the accepted redesigned physical/compute capacity envelope and make SRFDI-WP9 eligible for separate execution subject to all remaining programme prerequisites.

freeze_criteria.condition: Exact reference equivalence established for optimized distance and all required family methods
H0 capture plus measured I/O/fsync/rename/storage evidence complete
Multi-N capacity evidence is reproducible and measurement classes are explicit
Every required method has an explicit capacity status
No CAPACITY_UNRESOLVED status remains in the proposed T0 path
Storage, RSS and runtime models reconcile within T0 without hidden sampling, cache credit or parallel credit
Unsupported methods/configurations are not silently omitted
No accepted but unimplemented capacity remediation remains likely to materially alter this T0 disposition
June and Validation firewalls remain intact

warnings: N=2048 and N=4096+ were not directly measured; the 8598 capacity result remains an explicit extrapolation from the measured N64-N1024 ladder.
The 8598 population is not a frozen SRFD eligible population and is not June authorization.
The WP6 GitHub-hosted H0 CPU fingerprint differs from WP0, so cross-run pure speedup ratios are not used.
H2 remains provisional until a lawful long-horizon population is bound.
FREEZE_MEASURED_CAPACITY would make WP9 eligible only; it does not itself execute WP9 or authorize June.
rollback: If FREEZE is not approved, preserve the accepted G8R evidence and G6 merge, retain the original SRFDI-G8 REDESIGN disposition, keep WP9 blocked, and either REDESIGN, DEFER or BLOCK according to the operator decision.
next_action_after_freeze: Record the represented G8 freeze and make SRFDI-WP9 eligible, while preserving the separate SRFDI-G-JUNE-AUTH boundary before any June benchmark execution.
